title: BCMoney
tagline: BCMoney lives on-chain and off-chain and simplifies the movement of money with no fees.
description: BCMoney stands for blockchain money. The aim is to provide a Web2 interface and flow so users can transact in crypto without navigating through Web3 constructs. Crypto constructs like public and private addresses, smart contracts and fees generally complicate payment processes. Paying for anything should be simple. Fees only enter the picture when blockchain onramps and offramps are used.
how_its_made: This project will use Google's Firebase for authentication and for managing user accounts. It will also use an Ethereum testnet as the testing blockchain layer. Additionally, since vibe coding and AI technology permeates the coding stack, I will embark on my first use of vibe coding.
